title: Andy Reid on signing Justin Tucker to practice squad: "He's done his suspension"

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Andy Reid on signing Justin Tucker to practice squad: "He's done his suspension"
sources.description: Even before the Ravens cut Justin Tucker, which happened before Tucker accepted a 10-game suspension under the Personal Conduct Policy based on allegations of sexual misconduct at massage-therapy sessions, Tucker's skills were declining.
